short_summary: DC (10.10.20.45) breached via Workstation (10.10.20.15) kernel exploit. Backup Server (10.10.20.25) compromise.
executive_summary: Simulated attack initiated on (10.10.20.15) (WORKSTATION-01) resulted in a CRITICAL risk environment. The AI engine successfully pivoted through the network, affecting 5 critical assets including the Domain Controller and Backup Server.

attack_path.remediation: Update firewall rules and IDS/IPS signatures.
Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and tighten email filters.
Audit account privileges and enforce Privileged Access Management (PAM).
Apply the latest OS kernel patches and security updates.
Implement network micro-segmentation and restrict RDP/SSH access.

attack_path.description: Backup data discovery and collection on BACKUP-SERVER-01 (10.10.20.25)
attack_path.remediation: Restrict access, enforce least-privilege permissions, and isolate backup infrastructure.
